## III B. Tech ECE students visit NRSC for insights on Remote Sensing Applications

News Date : 19 Apr 2023News ReportThe III B. Tech ECE students of MGIT recently had the opportunity to visit the NRSC outreach facility in Jeedimetla, Hyderabad, on 19/4/2023. The visit provided them with valuable insights into remote sensing applications and the latest trends in mobile and compact satellite ground stations, as well as coding techniques for satellite data reception and processing. Some of the students were also given the opportunity to give technical presentations on these topics, showcasing their knowledge and innovation in the field. The visit was a great learning experience for the students and helped to broaden their understanding of the industry.
